work.summary: Building and administering a Proxmox server and a privacy-first local AI lab: two tracks that sharpen entreprise-grade skills. Homelab — virtualization with Proxmox Virtual Environment, Linux administration, networking, RBAC and zero-trust access control, data storage and backups, containers and orchestration, infrastructure as code and CI/CD, evolved following community best practices. Local AI — serving open-weight models on my own hardware with sandboxing and audit logging; prioritizing privacy, sovereignty, reliability, and performance; exposing the stack to any agent framework or harness with secure remote access from any trusted devices, anywhere; Learning and experimenting with new tools and practices.

work.summary: Designing, developing, testing, documenting, and packaging software. Creating an innovative pulse shaping framework (shapr) to overcome major challenges in the domain of ultrafast spectroscopy. Designing novel data acquisition techniques and data processing algorithms. Managing laboratory equipment and assets (lasers, spectrometers, spatial-light modulators). Maintaining and optimizing high-power femtosecond lasers (oscillator, amplifier, stretcher, compressor). Investigating light-matter interaction to understand and control the dynamics of energy conversion and transfer in macromolecules.
